# Final model and calibration intervals (generated by `python -m polysafe.final_model`)

PREREGISTRATION D12.1, specified after all model results were seen. The D7.2 primary specification fitted once on all 671 primary-cohort stays. Coefficients are per standard deviation of the design column (after median imputation); indicators are 1 when the named features are missing. **Its apparent performance is not reported**: all performance figures are the cross-validated ones in `results/models.md`.

## Calibration of the pooled out-of-fold predictions (95% patient-level BCa)

| Model | Intercept | Slope |
|---|---|---|
| Reduced LR, clinical only | +0.001 (-0.239 to +0.229) | 1.052 (0.597 to 1.540) |
| Reduced LR, clinical + medication | +0.000 (-0.241 to +0.229) | 1.124 (0.694 to 1.571) |
| LightGBM, clinical only | +0.097 (-0.153 to +0.332) | 0.805 (0.492 to 1.124) |
| LightGBM, clinical + medication | +0.100 (-0.150 to +0.337) | 0.812 (0.501 to 1.135) |

Coverage of these intervals: not measured.
